title: PaymentRpcRequest
description: Body of a message published by order-service to queue 'payment.rpc.request' (Flow 1). AMQP properties: reply_to = amq.rabbitmq.reply-to (Direct Reply-to) and correlation_id are managed by RabbitTemplate. The business correlation id travels in header 'x-correlation-id'. Mirrors RecordPaymentRequest in payment.proto.

partner_transaction_id.description: TXN-{partner_order_id} (D2); payment is idempotent on it

amount.description: VND, integer (D18). Payment replies REJECTED when <= 0
